jobs.occupation: PhD-position on  Multiscale Simulation of Cold Gas Spraying Processes (d/f/m) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description: About usAirbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.Job descriptionIn order to support our development of the cold spray process for deposition of Aluminum layers, Airbus Defence and Space offers aPhD-position on Multiscale Simulation of Cold Gas Spraying Processes for the Prediction of Repair Quality (d/f/m)Are you looking for a PhD Thesis topic in material science and engineering? Then apply now! We look forward to you joining us at Airbus Central Research & Technology.- Location: Taufkirchen/Ottobrunn- Start: as soon as possible- Duration: 36 monthsCold Gas Spraying (CGS) has established itself as a promising process for the repair of metallic components in safety-critical applications. The quality of the repair depends significantly on complex physical phenomena – such as particle deformation, interface bonding, oxide film disruption, and local thermomechanical effects. A deep understanding of these processes is crucial to ensure the structural integrity and long-term stability of the repaired components.Currently, however, there is a lack of a validated simulation approach that combines in-depth physical insights with long-term applicability in industrial development processes. Various numerical methods – from continuum-based to particle-based approaches – have already made valuable contributions to understanding local process phenomena such as plastic deformation, adiabatic heating, and interface formation in research.This doctoral thesis aims to develop a holistic simulation framework that represents these physical effects across multiple scales. The goal is to create a robust, interpretable, and sustainably usable model that can simulate both single-particle interactions and macroscopic coating build-up scenarios under realistic process conditions.The focus lies on methods based on software platforms that are established in industrial environments, available in the long term, and widely maintained. At the same time, supplementary investigations using alternative approaches (e.g., particle-based methods such as SPH or DEM) may be conducted in a research context to deepen insights or validate model assumptions.Your locationOur site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.Your benefits- Attractive salary and work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime).- Traveling to Airbus sites and overseas (conferences).- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.- Work with modern/diversified technologies.- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.Your tasks and responsibilities- Analysis of the state of the art in numerical methods for simulating Cold Gas Spraying processes, with a focus on continuum mechanics approaches (Lagrange, Euler, CFD).- Development and validation of simulation models to describe particle-substrate interaction, including plastic deformation, adiabatic heating, and interface formation.- Modeling of damage mechanisms such as incomplete oxide disruption, delamination, or local crack initiation.- Coupling of CFD and solid body simulation models for a holistic representation of the process (optional).- Integration and correlation of simulation results with experimental data from accompanying projects (e.g., microstructure, process monitoring).Desired skills and qualifications- Completed university master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, Computational Mechanics, Materials Science, or a related engineering or natural science field.- Solid knowledge in solid mechanics, plasticity theory, and numerical methods (FEM, CFD).- Experience with simulation software (e.g., Abaqus, ANSYS, LS-DYNA).- Basic understanding of coating processes or additive manufacturing technologies.- Analytical thinking and the ability to model complex physical relationships.- Creative problem-solving skills and an innovative mindset.- Structured, self-reliant work style and enthusiasm for interdisciplinary research.- Programming skills (Python, Fortran, C++) for the automation and scripting of simulation runs are an advantage.- Very good English skills in writing and speaking, good German skills.Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!#MYCYMThis job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growthBy submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.occupation: Project Manager Study Coordination (f/x/m) (Psychologe/Psychologin)
jobs.description: Our missionEvery 3 seconds, somewhere in the world, a person develops dementia. Today, more than 55 million people worldwide are living with dementia, and due to the aging population, this number is expected to rise to 78 million by 2030 and 139 million by 2050. The World Health Organization therefore classifies dementia as a public health priority. Even though dementia is still incurable, there have been significant developments in this field recently: disease-modifying drugs for the early stages of Alzheimer's disease have now been approved for the first time. We have made it our mission to enable early medical assessment and continuous monitoring of memory problems associated with Alzheimer's disease. That is why we have developed digital cognitive tests that are embedded in smartphone apps and can be used in research or healthcare.Your responsibilitiesneotiv develops digital cognitive assessments to detect and monitor cognitive impairment along the Alzheimer’s disease continuum. Our assessments are used as outcome measures in pharma-sponsored clinical trials and academic studies. To strengthen our Science & Innovation Team, we are looking for a Project Manager Study Coordination (35 hours/week, based in Magdeburg, Berlin, or remotely) who will take responsibility for delivering these studies from setup to close-out, serving as the main point of contact for sponsors, CROs, and study sites. The position is fixed-term until 31 January 2028 as parental leave cover, with the prospect of an extension or a permanent position.• Plan, set up, run and close studies and clinical trials in which neotiv assessments are used, including milestone and timeline tracking against contractual scopes of work.• Act as the main point of contact for sponsors, CROs, academic partners and study sites, and build and maintain strong working relationships with them.• Coordinate the study setup and configuration of the neotivPortal and neotivTrials app, including user acceptance testing (UAT) with the sponsor.• Plan and deliver site and study-team trainings and prepare onboarding materials, also in multiple languages.• Prepare study documentation and protocols, and support ethics/IRB and funding applications.• Manage change requests and scope questions in close alignment with our product, development and support teams.• Help acquire new project partners and keep track of scientific developments relevant to neotiv.Your profile• MSc in Psychology, Neuroscience, Neurology, Medicine or a related field. A PhD is an advantage.• 3–5 years of professional experience managing clinical and/or academic research studies. Experience on the vendor or technology-provider side of clinical trials (e.g. digital biomarker, CRO or similar), working with pharma sponsors, is strongly preferred.• Good knowledge of the clinical trial setting, ideally including ethics/IRB submissions, site training and sponsor/CRO collaboration.• Experience leading project teams and coordinating multiple stakeholders and workstreams in parallel.• Interest in and knowledge of cognitive neuroscience and neurodegeneration. Knowledge of digital health and precision medicine is a plus.• Fluent German and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.• Confident use of Microsoft 365 and common project management tools (Jira/Confluence).• A reliable, structured way of working with a strong eye for detail, and the ability to stay calm and flexible when timelines or requirements change.• Willingness to travel occasionally.What we have to offer• Flexible working from our offices in Magdeburg and Berlin, or from home.• Flexible working hours and 30 days of annual leave.• Monthly benefits worth €65 net (mobility allowance, non-cash benefit and/or Urban Sports Club membership).• A childcare allowance of up to €135 net per month, if needed.• An occupational pension scheme, with the employer contribution rising to up to 80% with length of service.• A training budget for your professional and personal development.• Monthly Creative Days for new ideas, collaboration and room to develop creatively.• A great team that enjoys its work and is committed to high standards of quality and professionalism.Your point of contactSend us your CV and cover letter, addressed to our People & Culture Team. If you have questions, we are happy to answer them by email at jobs@neotiv.com or by phone.About usneotiv is a team of currently about 30 people: Scientists, developers and technically enthusiastic people who share a common vision of a better prevention of dementia. We develop digital solutions for the early detection and monitoring of memory problems.neotiv is a spin-off from Otto-von-Guericke-University Magdeburg in close cooperation with the German Centre for Neurodegenerative Diseases (DZNE). Our team is passionate about shaping the future of medical care with digital tools and advancing dementia research. We work in Magdeburg, Berlin and across Germany and Europe. We are funded by renowned investors and science transfer funds that enable us to realize our mission of improving people's lives.

Experience working across multiple markets is a plus.• Native or near-native German and fluent English. Dutch is a plus.Are we a match?A lot works differently here than in a classic company:• We try things out, decide quickly and correct just as quickly.• You carry real responsibility.
